_help: How the job applier runs. Keys starting with _ are notes. See references/setup.md.
_email: The mailbox used on applications. It sends the reports and reads verification codes (IMAP). Gmail: turn on 2-step verification and create an app password.
_ntfy_topic: Optional phone notification after every run: pick a long random topic name and subscribe to it in the ntfy app.
_live_ats: Sites where the applier may press Submit. Empty = dry runs only (fills forms, never submits). Add "greenhouse", "ashby", "lever" one at a time after reviewing dry runs with the person.
_indeed: true only if the Indeed connector is enabled in the person's Claude account (claude.ai connectors).
_resume_pages: 1 or 2. The layout check fits the resume to exactly this many full pages.
